entries.excerpt: So, I might get razzed for this - but I figured I'd come to a place where I would receive useful insight on my situation. Dilemna Zillow wants to buy the domain that a website (optimized for iPhone which uses their API) I've created resides on for literally "a couple hundred bucks". entries.title: Ask HN: Why no love for PHP?

Do the developers who visit this site all code in Ruby, Erlang or Objective-C? Are PHP developers a minority in this community? entries.title: Ask HN: What apps are essential for mac?

entries.current_title: Ask HN: What apps are essential for mac?
entries.excerpt: Just purchased my first macbook and I'm already digging it.
